title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
summary: Count the nodes on the longest path from the root down to a leaf.

tests.explain: The longest root-to-leaf path is 1 → 2 → 5 → 7, which has 4 nodes.
The root has only a right child: 1 → 2 is 2 nodes.
An empty tree has no nodes, so its depth is 0.

hints: The depth of a tree is 1 for the root plus the depth of its deeper subtree.
What should an empty subtree (null) return so that a leaf comes out as 1?
Return 0 for null, otherwise 1 + Math.max(maxDepth(root.left), maxDepth(root.right)). Counting levels with a BFS works too.

complexity.time: O(n): every node is visited once
complexity.space: O(h) for the recursion: O(log n) when balanced, O(n) for a skewed tree
